method: The dialogue JSONL was read as contiguous Unicode character pages with complete record text and source_refs. Assigned project and external files were concatenated in assignment order with file-boundary markers and inspected in bounded contiguous pages; long JSON and CSV fields were retained. Quantitative claims used in the report were rechecked against line-numbered source records and the new Astra01-Astra03 reports.
tool_output_policy: No archived tool-output record is claimed as read; no dialogue claim requiring an unassigned archived output was promoted beyond its assigned source record.
